thread:
Simran: Quick personal update — accepted promotion to Staff Engineer starting July 15 :tada: Also, Priya said yes to a proposal this weekend (💍) and were getting a foster-to-adopt pup next Saturday 🐶 Overwhelmed in the best way. Thinking a small potluck next Friday to celebrate?

Julia: WHAT!!! congrats congrats congrats :tada::tada::tada:

Oliver: omg amazing. count me in for potluck. i can bring a savoy mashed potatoes or something. cake?

Zoe: triple congrats!!! :heart_eyes: ill bring a big chocolate cake. also priestly question: registry link?

Simran: thanks y'all!! no registry for my promo — just hugs. for the engagement Priya made a small wishlist: https://tinyurl.com/priya-wishlist (link)

Simran: pup foster profile + pics: https://imgur.com/example-pup (he's a goof)

people-ops-bot: @channel If youre planning a group gift or contribution, please use this form so we can handle reimbursement/gift receipt: https://forms.gle/example-form — opt-in only. :white_check_mark:

Liya: Poll for potluck time — adding options here so folks can react: 
```
1) Fri 12:00
2) Fri 15:00
3) Fri 17:00
```

Oliver: 12:00 preferred for me. also cake > pie.

Julia: 17:00 works so people can swing by after work, but 12:00 is fine too.

Zoe: RSVP yes. bringing cake + forks + napkins :utensils:

Marco: congrats Simran!! Priya!! can't wait to meet the pup. want to bring a tiny gift for the pup — leash/treats recs?

Simran: leash from local shelter recommended — anything small is perfect. thanks for all the love. no speeches pls, just snacks and low-key celebration. ❤️

Liya: noted. will tally reactions by Wednesday and book conference room A for food.

Julia: sending a little congrats gif in thread :sparkles:
notes: Informal watercooler thread about promotion, engagement, and a new foster pup plus potluck coordination. Contains links, a short poll, and a people-ops bot reminder.
